title: Subtle Creepiness
description:
A little something to make your gameplay a little creepier. 
Not made to overwhelm, but you will definitely notice the difference
body:
Something to make your gameplay a bit more realistic, as well as creepier, while staying within the 16-bit style. mostly using subtle animation.
Makes grass flow in the wind, and some kinds of wood have animations to look more, well, animated.
